title: The North Face Transgrancanaria 2027 — regulations
publisher: The North Face Transgrancanaria / Arista Eventos S.L.
claims: Article 2 lists the 2027 race dates: Open 23 February 09:00, KV El Gigante 24 February 15:00, Promo 25 February 10:30, Half 25 February 09:00, Marathon 26 February 09:30, Classic 26 February 23:59, Advanced and Short/Family Trail 27 February at 09:00 and 10:00.
The Stages format combines four races over four days: Open Agáldar as stage 1, KV El Gigante as stage 2, Promo as stage 3 and Advanced as stage 4.
Article 5.3 requires a medical certificate for Classic, Advanced and Stages runners and sets the upload deadline at 21 January 2027, while the Classic race page gives 14 January 2027.

Article 8.2 allows external assistance only within 100 metres before and after an aid station and never inside it, and lists the permitted points per race; Open Agáldar, Promo, Short, Family Trail and KV El Gigante do not allow external assistance.
Article 8.3 prohibits poles during the first 2 kilometres of every race except KV El Gigante, and requires runners to carry poles so they cannot injure other runners.
Article 10 states that aid stations provide no cups and that every runner must carry their own container.
Article 11 requires withdrawals to be made at aid stations with the bib handed in, and says the organisation may evacuate a runner to the finish area after the aid-station control closes.
The regulations reproduce Article 8.2 twice, with slightly different wording, in the same document.

Article 1 states that The North Face Transgrancanaria is organised by Arista Eventos S.L.U. in collaboration with the Cabildo de Gran Canaria, the town halls of the island and the Government of the Canary Islands.
